readings: Link each invoice line item to its order through its order_item_id (Invoice_Line_Items -> Order_Items -> Orders -> Customers), and take the town_city of the customer who placed that order. For each order_item_id and town, average product_price and the ratio derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost, ignoring NULLs. Then average those values per town. Return the towns whose average ratio is above the unweighted mean of the per-town average ratios. Show the town, its average price, its average ratio, and the unrounded difference between its ratio and that cross-town mean.

Link each invoice line item to its order through its invoice_number (Invoice_Line_Items -> Invoices -> Orders -> Customers), and take the town_city of the customer who placed that order. For each order_item_id and town, average product_price and the ratio derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost, ignoring NULLs. Then average those values per town. Return the towns whose average ratio is above the unweighted mean of the per-town average ratios. Show the town, its average price, its average ratio, and the unrounded difference between its ratio and that cross-town mean.
queries:
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city AS town,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_stats AS (
  SELECT town,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
)
SELECT town,
       avg_price,
       avg_ratio,
       avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_stats) AS ratio_diff
FROM town_stats
WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town_stats);

WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM town_avg
)
SELECT t.town_city,
       t.avg_price,
       t.avg_ratio,
       t.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS ratio_difference
FROM town_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio
